description_expanded: ABOUT GRAYTFUL A charming cottage in the heart of Grayton Beach, Florida, Graytful is a cozy 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat that comfortably sleeps up to 6 guests. It is pet-friendly and has a private fenced yard with an outdoor shower and a gas grill. Graytful sits at the end of a private drive that is shared by only four homes. It offers the perfect setting for couples, small families or a few friends looking for a laid-back, coastal retreat. Graytful is located within a short walking distance from the boutique shops and restaurants in Grayton Beach. Guests can also access the 30A Beach Shuttle Station, which offers free shuttle service to other public beach access points along Scenic 30A. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS    Cozy coastal cottage on a private drive    2 bed/2 bath    Sleeps up to 6 guests    Spacious primary suite with a king bed    Guest bedroom with a king bed    Living room with sleeper sofa    Luxurious duvet bedding in both rooms    Fully equipped kitchen    Pet-friendly    Fenced yard    Outdoor gas grill    Outdoor shower    Spacious back porch with seating    Laundry room with washer and dryer    Beach chairs and umbrella provided    WiFi & smart TV PARKING    Designated parking available onsite PROPERTY RULES    Must be 25 years or older to book    Maximum occupancy: 6 guests    Pet fee ($250 per pet)    No smoking permitted    Rental agreement must be signed within 48 hours of booking or reservation is subject to cancellation    All reservations are non-refundable - travel insurance is strongly encouraged ABOUT GRAYTON BEACH Grayton Beach is one of the most iconic and character-filled beach communities along Scenic 30A. Known for its laid-back atmosphere, local restaurants, artful personality, and beautiful beaches, Grayton Beach has a unique blend of old Florida charm and modern coastal living. It also offers easy access to Seaside, WaterColor, and Blue Mountain Beach, and a free shuttle service also stops at many locations west of Blue Mountain Beach. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class service from inquiry to checkout. All homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standards. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create unforgettable memories - one beach vacation at a time.
